jobs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production 2D transparent game sprite sheet. Output a THREE-COLUMN, TWO-ROW grid of equally sized cells, landscape 1536x1024 or larger same aspect. Exactly FIVE full plush toys in identical pots, all the SAME character and color; cell6 stays completely transparent. Row 1 left to right: IDLE (relaxed small smile, eyes open), ATTACK (rounded visible small O-shaped open mouth blowing upward, no bubble), SPENT (tired half-closed eyes, slightly slack mouth). Row2 left to right: READY (puffed cheeks, closed pursed mouth), BLINK (both eyes closed, relaxed small smile), EMPTY.
Each sprite including ears/leaves/fur/pot must fit entirely inside its OWN cell with at least 12% transparent margin on EVERY side. All pots share same size and bottom at 86% of EACH cell's height. Character centered at 50% of cell width. This margin is mandatory for game slicing: no overlap across cell boundaries, no cropping.
Style: faithfully match supplied approved plush art: dense visible fine SHORT fur, soft fibers following form, fluffy irregular edges, soft stuffed ears and cheeks, glossy toy eyes, two green felt leaves between head and pot, front-facing three-quarter view, warm soft upper-left light. Pot is matching-color soft felt with shallow tactile applique decorations. Keep texture of dense plush fur at small sprite size; no plastic animals, no smooth clay skin, no outlines, no long shaggy hairs. Exact same pose, proportions, lighting, pot and color across all five cells; ONLY eyes, eyebrows, cheeks and mouth change by state.
Transparent background with true alpha. No ground or cast shadow, no grid lines, labels, numbers, text, UI badges, bubbles, weapons or additional objects.
